note: GMUG NF campground at the north end of Taylor Park Reservoir where the Taylor River enters, ~9,300 ft: from Almont north on CO 135, then 28.3 mi up graded Taylor Canyon Rd (FR 742). Fishing access to the reservoir; the Matchless Trail trailhead is on the grounds; 4WD, OHV, mountain-bike and horse riding nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 15 sites, $18 (+$9 extra vehicle), vault toilets, drinking water, first-come only. Added season note 'Late Spring to Early Fall', fees checked 2026. FS page gives no rig length and recreation.gov's catalog has a single placeholder site with no length, so max_rig_ft stays unknown. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Phone missing: Gunnison Ranger District (970) 641-0471 (GMUG conditions page: 'Please contact the Gunnison Ranger District front office for road condition updates at 970-641-0471'). The campground page itself lists only the Supervisor's Office (970) 874-6600.

No rig length anywhere official: the FS page gives none and recreation.gov's catalog holds a single placeholder 'Standard' site with no Max Vehicle Length. Nothing singles the campground out for small rigs.

Waterfront (stored lakeview) checked both ways, no change: Esri World_Topo_Map draws the reservoir's full-pool shoreline ~30-80 m west of the campground loop (Rivers End Camp Ground road), so at full pool the west-side pads may sit within the lakefront distance bound; on Esri imagery (drawn-down reservoir, spring) open water is ~500+ m south-west across exposed lakebed, and the Taylor River (a narrow ~5-10 m stream) runs ~50-100 m west of the loops. DEM: loops ~2,850 m vs. lake ~2,841 m. With the shoreline moving that far, lakeview is the defensible call; a lakefront upgrade would need per-site evidence at normal summer pool.

Status: the FS page header shows 'Site Closed' (page last updated September 29, 2026), read as the ordinary end of its late-spring-to-early-fall season; no closure order names it. The only GMUG closure alert (Gold Mountain Fire, Ouray RD) covers other roads. The GMUG conditions page refers Gunnison RD road questions to the district office; FR 742 has no listed closure.

Pin 38.85844,-106.56570 is the FS/recreation.gov facility point, on FR 742 at the campground's entrance road; the loops lie ~100-300 m west-southwest. Within tolerance (no per-site coordinates exist).
